subject.title: feat: support Jina Embeddings v5 task parameter for task-specific adapters

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose typed `memorySearch.queryTask` and `memorySearch.documentTask` fields, or use a narrower generic provider request-options contract for embedding-only parameters?
rationale: Both approaches add public compatibility-sensitive configuration and plugin/provider API surface; code inspection can establish feasibility but cannot decide the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Use typed task fields
options.body: Adopt query/document task fields matching the existing asymmetric input-type pattern, with provider propagation, cache identity, validation, docs, and reindex guidance.

options.title: Use constrained request options
options.body: Expose a validated embedding-specific request-options object instead of adding new top-level fields for each provider parameter.

options.title: Keep Jina behavior external
options.body: Decline new core config and require a provider/plugin-owned implementation using existing extension seams or a deliberately extended plugin API.

recommendation.title: Use typed task fields
recommendation.body: Adopt query/document task fields matching the existing asymmetric input-type pattern, with provider propagation, cache identity, validation, docs, and reindex guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the OpenAI-compatible memory endpoint, provider runtime, and documentation surfaces where the product-boundary choice lands.
